SAPITS_FB_HELP_TEXT_DO=With this dialog you can choose a folder from the browser's own file system.\nIf no folder is selected, the root folder is chosen (Z:\u005c or z:\u005c in Microsoft Windows, /Z/ in other operating systems).
SAPITS_FB_HELP_TEXT_FB=All front-end service methods, such as download, upload, execute, etc. now operate on the browser's own file system, not on the native file system.
SAPITS_FB_HELP_TEXT_FO=With this dialog you can choose one or more files from the browser's own file system for upload.\n\nAs all front-end service methods now operate on the browser's own file system, the way to upload a file from the native file system has changed:\nFirst you import the file from the native file system to the browser's file system using the "Import" button on this dialog. Then you can select the file for upload.
SAPITS_FB_HELP_TEXT_FO2=This dialog is the starting point for choosing one or more files from the native file system for upload.\n\nAs all front-end service methods now operate on the browser's own file system, the way to upload a file from the native file system has changed:\nFirst you need to confirm this dialog to show the native file system's "Open file" dialog. The files you choose here will be uploaded to the browser's own file system, from where they can be uploaded to the server later on.
SAPITS_FB_HELP_TEXT_FS=With this dialog you can choose a file for download to the browser's own file system.\n\nAs all front-end service methods now operate on the browser's own file system, the way to download a file to the native file system has changed:\nFirst, select a file for download using this dialog. Once the download has completed, start the SAP GUI for HTML file browser and use the "Export" button to transfer the file to the native file system.
SAPITS_FB_HELP_TEXT_FS2=In this dialog you can enter a name for the file you want to save. It replaces the native file system's "Save file" dialog. This behavior can only be enforced by the browser settings.\n\nAs all front-end service methods now operate on the browser's own file system, the way to download a file to the native file system has changed:\nFirst, enter the name for the file you want to save using this dialog. Once the file has downloaded to the virtual file system, a copy of the file is downloaded to the native file system. Depending on the browser settings, the file is either downloaded to the "Downloads" folder, or the native file system's "Save file" dialog is displayed.
SAPITS_FB_HELP_TEXT_PART=All paths of the browser's file system start with Z:\u005c or z:\u005c (in Microsoft Windows) or with /Z/ (in other operating systems).\n\nTo look at the content of the browser's file system, you can start the SAP GUI for HTML file browser from the SAP GUI for HTML menu (under %s1 -\u003e %s2) or from the SAP GUI for HTML toolbar (under %s3 -\u003e %s2 or under %s4 -\u003e %s3 -\u003e %s2).\n\nHere you can do the following:\n1) Open files\n2) Export files from the browser's file system to the native file system\n3) Delete files and folders\n4) Create folders\n5) Import files from the native file system to the browser's file system\n\nFor details about the list download, please see SAP Note 2249454.
